resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 7,412 ft (2,259 m). Tahoe Quarterly gives 7,457 ft, and Peakbagging gives 7,461 ft. The register's figure is used in the record.

NHLR says roof repair began in fall 2025 under a planned restoration. Tahoe Quarterly describes the roof as missing and the second-floor staircase as gone. Its piece is dated 26 Sep and filed under Fall 2025, the same season the register gives for the repair start, so the two accounts may be close in time; the story reports both without choosing.
A different lookout, Pilot Peak Lookout on the Stanislaus National Forest (US 1394, Tuolumne County), has its own NHLR record. This record covers the Plumas National Forest lookout (US 600) only.

notes_for_editor: The Tahoe Quarterly piece carries '26 Sep' and is filed under 'Fall 2025', so its season matches the register's fall 2025 repair start; it is not dated more precisely. The NHLR 2007 visit report is the only detailed condition report. The brief's note about a different NHLR number is explained by the separate Stanislaus lookout (US 1394), which is excluded. No 2026 status was found, so 'standing, inactive' rests on the register and Tahoe Quarterly. No closure notice was found; access is recorded from the 2007 visit report and the Tahoe article. Used 5 page reads and 1 search.
